result_json.message: docs: review repair-plan integration with issue resolution

items.title: Reconcile workflow assets and preserve the issue-plan contract
items.reason: The Phase 5 inventory names nonexistent author-revise-plan.md while omitting author-process-plan-review.md, reviewer-plan-continued.md, and the newly merged issue-resolution consumer. These assets own final corrections, pinned Issue Coverage, and the explicit PLAN_RUN-to-IMPL_RUN handoff.
items.failure: Implementing the listed assets can leave actual revision and issue handoffs without repair guidance, reject or expand a valid compact plan, or lose pinned Source brief and verbatim AC coverage during otherwise mechanical recovery.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Update Phase 5, asset matrix, Files Touched and snapshot counts with the actual revision/continued prompts and issue skill Steps 2/3; document unaffected delegation where no edit is needed. Add focused compact-fixture and rendered-asset acceptance preserving one-phase structure, prose gates, Source brief, AC text/mappings, assumptions and snapshots, with only review findings in Addresses. Exercise completed-source finalization/repair into explicit binding and same-implementation-run repair with existing authorization and evidence, without new gates or runs.

items.title: Verify mechanical receipts through delivery identity and closure
items.reason: The repair lifecycle acceptance stops at phase/run continuation. The merged issue workflow consumes sealed records through accepted-intervals and classify-delivery, whose existing fixtures cover review/checkbox/seal commits but not the proposed repair/finalization receipts or preserved settled chains.
items.failure: A successful same-run repair could still leave issue delivery unsettled or uncovered and block closure; treating a repair receipt as acceptance could instead allow unsettled phases or unrelated code to reach success publication.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Add precise Phase 5 regressions to issue-resolution-recipes.test.ts and its existing helper using codec-valid new records and plan/record-only commits. Execute the shipped recipes for ordinary settled review and exact proof-bound correction carried across repair, plus finalization-to-binding provenance; preserve accepted code endpoints and require evidence-only receipt commits and delivery: ok without extra review/quality or replacement runs. Retain a negative unsettled/uncovered companion and existing no-success-publication behavior. Modify recipe text only if a concrete incompatibility appears; do not widen ranges/exclusions or add receipt-based approval or closure rules.

result_json.summary: The repair-first design remains valid after integration. Two bounded plan corrections are needed for the actual workflow assets, compact/Issue Coverage preservation, and regression coverage of the new receipts through issue delivery; no new approval policy, run restart, or issue-resolution redesign is required.

baselineAssessment.reason: Independent estimate from Git/journal repair proof, interruption and replay handling, exact committed approval reconciliation and sealed-source compatibility, shared parser and boundary wiring, routing/context repairs, and effective workflow acceptance. Existing folds and paired-store facilities reduce invention, but evidence-preserving cross-boundary recovery dominates effort; integration findings carry separate incremental estimates.
